title: Represent printed decorative marks as semantic objects
when: Angle arrows, equal-angle ticks, dashed dimensions or shading communicate source meaning.
do: Use explicit primitive types and semantic owner references.
Separate a leader-arrow pointing at an angle from a parallel-arrow attached to a segment.
Bind equal-angle/length marks through a relation ID; preserve fill and dash style separately from provenance.
check: All required source marks mapped to an output object; no extra mark introduced.
limitation: A visually similar path without owner/ray binding is insufficient for semantic edits.
